note: Both sets capture the core facts (2500 g martensite, 2900 g austenite, 400 g total actuation force, 15-20 C austenite range, 10 g per louver) and both repeat the same fabricated splice quote for the 10 g criterion and the same misread 'Austenite --deformation--> Martensite' transition (the diagram's deformation arrow runs between the two Martensite states). Set A additionally invents a '-200C' lower bound not in the text and loosely binds the 400 g actuation force to the shading mechanism rather than the wire. Set B makes more binding errors around the 10 g figure, calling it 'maximum friction' and attaching it to 'axial rotation points' and to the 'Flexinol actuated shading system' instead of per louver, and adds a further non-verbatim quote. Overall A is somewhat cleaner, though both are heavily duplicated.
